chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from al-Hasan ibn Ali from Isa al-Farra' from Abd Allah ibn Abi Ya'fur from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) performed Hajj twenty times, keeping it secret, in all of which he would pass between the two Ma'azim, then descend, urinate, and perform ritual purification.

key_terms.بَيْنَ الْمَأْزِمَيْنِ: between the two Ma'azim (a place in Mecca)

ai.seo_question: How many times did the Prophet perform Hajj and what ritual did he perform between the Ma'azim?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the Prophet Muhammad’s (peace be upon him and his family) meticulous adherence to ritual purity (taharah) even during the sacred state of Ihram, demonstrating that natural bodily functions do not break the pilgrimage status. By specifying the location between the two Ma'azim, the narration provides precise geographical context for the Prophet’s practice, which serves as a legal precedent (sunna) for the permissibility of urinating and performing istinja during Hajj without invalidating the rites.
